meta.scope_note: Catalog scope = actual model-data fields only: parameters that define the hydraulic/geometric model and would be read/written via the HEC-RASController COM interface (Phase 1). Pure UI/display chrome (schematic colors, zoom/pan, view-toggle checkboxes for what's drawn on screen, cut/copy/paste/undo mechanics, delete-record actions, navigation dropdowns that don't carry new data) is explicitly OUT of scope - it's not modeling capability and COM does not expose it. Scope was corrected to this definition on 2026-08-26 after an initial pass briefly included UI chrome; the UI-chrome entries from that pass were removed rather than kept in a mixed catalog.

meta.status: IN PROGRESS. Geometry Editor: covers manual §6.1-6.3 (River System Schematic, Cross Section Data, Stream Junctions) and §6.8 (Storage Areas). 2D Flow Areas: covers §6.9 (boundary, break lines, computational mesh generation/editing, mesh pre-processing tolerances). Structures: covers §6.4-6.7 (Bridges, Culverts, Multiple Openings, Inline Structures, Lateral Structures), §6.10 (SA/2D Area Connections incl. HTAB params and linear routing), and §6.12 (Pump Stations incl. groups, efficiency curves, operations, advanced control rules) - entered via the same Geometric Data Editor UI but tagged module=Structures per the plan's Phase 0 module list. §6.11 (SA/2D external BC lines) was already covered by the geom.schematic.sa2d_bcline.* entries; the BC type/data itself belongs to the Unsteady Flow Editor. Remaining Geometry Editor sections (6.13-6.22: XS Interpolation, River Ice, Tables views, Import, Tools, Options, Georeferencing, Pictures, Saving) and remaining modules (Sediment, Water Quality, Plan/Run Manager, RAS Mapper) not yet catalogued. Steady Flow Editor: covers UM §7.1 (flow data, profiles, all Options-menu data entries, DSS connections) with BC types sourced from HRM-6.0 Ch.3 p.143-144 because UM 6.4.1's steady chapter does not restate the Reach Boundary Conditions dialog. Excluded per scope (import actions, not persisted model data): the DSS Import dialog's transient settings (time window, interval-vs-peak extraction choice, interpolation option) and 'Import from an Existing Output Profile'. Flow Regime (Subcritical/Supercritical/Mixed) lives on the Steady Flow Analysis window -> Plan/Run Manager module. Unsteady Flow Editor: covers UM §8.6 (all BC types, Initial Conditions, Options, Observed Data, water temperature) plus SA/2D BC data and the full Meteorological Data tab from 2DUM-6.6 Ch.5 p.141-193 (external/internal 2D BCs, spatially variable stage, global precip/ET/wind/atmospheric pressure, 2D initial conditions incl. IC Points and results-file interpolation). New placeholders pending deeper sourcing: Navigation Dam operation fields and the unsteady Rules editor rule language (both detailed in UM 'Advanced Features for Unsteady Flow Routing', p.626+); allowable Data-time-interval enum values for hydrograph tables not enumerated in the manual text (verify against live 7.0 UI). 2D Initial Conditions Ramp Up Time and model warm-up settings are on the Unsteady Flow Analysis window -> Plan/Run Manager module. Flagged for further sourcing (not yet done): WSPRO Abutment Type's 4 option labels, FHWA Chart#/Scale# value sets for culverts, and the 11 Kindsvater-Carter equation forms for gate weir flow. Several fields launched from Structures editors (Breach parameters, unsteady Rules) and the 2D Land-Use/Manning's n table are placeholders only - their full field sets belong to not-yet-catalogued modules (Unsteady Flow Editor, Plan/Run Manager, RAS Mapper). Geometry Editor §6.13-6.22 (remainder of the module) now covered: §6.13 Cross Section Interpolation (max distance, decimal places, cut-line GIS method, master cords, constant-distance and set-location options — flagged: unclear from manual text whether these persist as ongoing settings or are transient per-run parameters, needs live-7.0 confirmation); §6.14 River Ice (full Ice Cover Editor data set, per-bridge ice option, and the four ice-jam calculation tolerances); §6.15 Viewing/Editing Data through Tables — most subsections are table views of fields already catalogued elsewhere and were deliberately NOT duplicated (Manning's n/k, Reach Lengths, Contraction/Expansion Coefficients, Bank Stations, Levees, River/Reach/Junction/Storage-Area/Connection/Pump-Station Names, Bridge Width Table, Weir and Gate Coefficient Table, HTAB Internal Boundaries Table, Linear Routing Coefficients, Manning's n by Land Classification [already 2d.mesh.landuse_mannings_table], Picture File Associations [already geom.xs.picture_attach]) — only genuinely new fields were added: Minor Losses (K coefficient), Node Names, Node Descriptions, Ineffective Flow Area trigger elevations, and the Preissmann Slot per-lidded-XS toggle. §6.16 Importing Geometric Data was reviewed and entirely excluded per scope (file-format import wizards and one-time import actions, not persisted model fields — consistent with the existing DSS-import exclusion). §6.17 Geometric Data Tools: most tools are one-time transform/cleanup actions on already-catalogued fields and were excluded (Graphical XS Editor, Bank Station Tools, Persistent Scale, Compare/Merge Geometry Files, Channel Bank Stations, Reverse Stationing, Cross Section Points Filter, Ineffective Areas Set-to-Permanent/Fix-Overlapping/Convert-to-Single, Manning's n Set-Channel-to-Single-Value, Vertical Datum Adjustment, Reach Connectivity, Reach Order for Computations/Find Loops); Fixed Sediment Elevations, Pilot Channels, Flow Roughness Factors, and Seasonal Roughness Factors ARE persisted (the manual explicitly states Flow Roughness Factors are "saved with the geometry data") and were added. Reach Order for Computations may allow a persisted manual override of the auto-computed reach sequence — flagged for live-software confirmation rather than added speculatively. §6.18 Geometric Data Options: Main Channel Manning's n Value Compositing and Hydrologic Unsteady Routing (incl. Modified Puls routing reach regions and the steady-flow-plan rating-curve source) were added in full. §6.19-6.20 Georeferencing: almost entirely GIS coordinate-system/projection tooling and one-time coordinate transforms, excluded per scope (Reach Invert Lines/XS Cut Lines coordinate editing IS included below since it's persisted geometry, but GIS Cut Lines transform tools, GIS Coordinate Operations, Plot GIS Profile Reach Bounds/Bounding Polygon, and Limit GIS Bounds to Bridge Openings were excluded as one-time actions or display/output artifacts, not input model data); four new persisted geometry fields were added: XS cut line GIS coordinates, GIS levee line coordinates, Manning's n calibration region polygons, and GIS (RAS-Mapper-drawn) ineffective flow area polygons — the last one is flagged as possibly belonging to a not-yet-catalogued RAS Mapper module rather than Geometry Editor. Lateral Structure Centerline and Culvert Barrel Centerline GIS tables were confirmed as duplicates of struct.lateral.geospatial_centerline and struct.culvert.barrel_gis_data respectively and were not re-added. §6.21 Attaching and Viewing Pictures was confirmed as a duplicate of the existing geom.xs.picture_attach field (the manual confirms only the file path is persisted, one picture per object) and was not re-added. §6.22 Saving the Geometric Data is a save action, not model data, and was excluded. Geometry Editor module is now considered fully catalogued (§6.1-6.22). Remaining modules not yet catalogued: Sediment Transport, Water Quality, Plan/Run Manager, RAS Mapper.
